LESSON: READING 13.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: INDEPENDENT READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.2: Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to read newspapers and magazines?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a variety of grade- appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers and magazines for lifelong learning
2. demonstrate independent reading of grade-appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers, magazines and articles for information and enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 13.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: INDEPENDENT READING
This lesson teaches Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. read a variety of grade- appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers and magazines for lifelong learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. demonstrate independent reading of grade-appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers, magazines and articles for information and enjoyment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading above.
2. Explain Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to read newspapers and magazines?
2. How do we choose the materials we read?
3. When do we read?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a variety of grade- appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers and magazines for lifelong learning
2. demonstrate independent reading of grade-appropriate digital and print texts such as newspapers, magazines and articles for information and enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
